# Pixel Memory Match

A fully offline, browser-based memory-match game built with HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript.

## How to Play

- Click or tap a card to flip it.
- Flip two cards at a time.
- If the two cards match (same color), they stay open.
- If they don't match, they flip back after a short delay.
- Match all 8 pairs to win!
- The move counter tracks how many pairs you've flipped.
- Click **New Game** to reshuffle and start over.

## Features

- 8 pairs of colored cards (16 cards total).
- Shuffled deck on every new game.
- Move counter and win message.
- Keyboard accessible: all cards and the New Game button are focusable and operable with Enter/Space.
- Responsive layout that works from 360px wide.
- No external assets, no network requests, no inline event handlers.

## Files

- `index.html` – structure and content.
- `styles.css` – theming, layout, and visual states.
- `script.js` – game logic and interactivity.

## Running

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or build step required.

## Accessibility

- Cards are buttons with descriptive `aria-label` attributes.
- The board uses `role="grid"` and cards use `role="gridcell"`.
- The move counter uses `aria-live="polite"` to announce updates.
- The win message uses `role="alert"`.
- Visible focus outlines on all interactive elements.
- The `[hidden]` CSS rule ensures hidden elements are never displayed.
